Secret Service smoked brisket sliders.veg: Two years with Carter and four with Reagan. Smoky mushrooms, pickles and hot mustard on milk buns.

Katana-cut seared tuna with ponzu.veg: Sesame-crusted tofu, ponzu and spring onion. Frank's sword slices Rachel's scarf in two.

Miami benefit snapper with mango salsa.veg: Rachel meets Portman at the Miami party. Grilled haloumi, mango salsa and coconut rice.

Herb Farmer's lake cabin beef pot pie.veg: Mushrooms, lentils and thyme under flaky pastry. Hiding out at Herb's cabin on the lake.

The bodyguard's orange juice, straight o.af: Blood orange juice and soda, the way Frank takes it. Frank asks for orange juice on the job.
